archetypes.name: dyn-runtime-evidence
archetypes.rationale: Runtime artifacts and report overlays add stale-evidence and accounting risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the analyze-bugs runtime stage from artifact creation through report consumption. Verify that runtime failures cannot be overwritten by deep truncation, stale bindings do not affect current rows, and verified snapshots only include certifiable fixed outcomes. Check that the documented coordinator order matches the CLI contract. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
